ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The block diagram of a feedback control system is shown in the figure. Determine the transfer function \(\frac{Y(s)}{X(s)}\) of the system.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the input on the left is X(s), entering the left summing node, and the input terminal is marked with a plus sign; the feedback branch returning to this node from below is marked with a minus sign. The output signal of the left summing node splits to the right into two forward channels: one enters G_1, and the other goes upward into G_2. The output of G_1 on the one hand enters the positive input of the right summing node, and on the other hand returns through the lower feedback block H to the negative input of the left summing node. The output of G_2 also enters the positive input of the right summing node. The output of the right summing node is Y(s). Reasoning: Let the output of the left summing node be e(s). Since the feedback signal comes from the output of G_1 and passes through H, the feedback quantity is H G_1 e(s), and it is subtracted at the left summing node, so e(s)=X(s)-H G_1 e(s). Rearranging gives e(s)(1+G_1H)=X(s), so e(s)/X(s)=1/(1+G_1H). The right summing node adds the two forward signals: the signal from G_1 is G_1 e(s), and the signal from G_2 is G_2 e(s), therefore Y(s)=(G_1+G_2)e(s). Substituting e(s)/X(s), we obtain Y(s)/X(s)=(G_1+G_2)/(1+G_1H).

raw_record.question_text:
The block diagram of a feedback control system is shown in the figure.

Determine the transfer function \(\frac{Y(s)}{X(s)}\) of the system.

method.method_draft: Define the output of the left summing junction as e(s). From the image, the signal through G1 is G1 e(s), and this same G1 output is fed through H and subtracted at the left summing node. Therefore write e(s)=X(s)-H G1 e(s), giving e(s)/X(s)=1/(1+G1H). The right summing node adds the two positive forward signals G1 e(s) and G2 e(s), so Y(s)=(G1+G2)e(s). Substitute e(s)/X(s) to obtain Y(s)/X(s)=(G1+G2)/(1+G1H).
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧输入为 X(s)，进入左侧求和节点，输入端标有正号；从下方回到该节点的反馈支路标有负号。左侧求和节点的输出信号向右分成两条前向通道：一条进入 G_1，另一条向上进入 G_2。G_1 的输出一方面进入右侧求和节点的正输入，另一方面经下方反馈块 H 返回左侧求和节点的负输入。G_2 的输出也进入右侧求和节点的正输入。右侧求和节点输出为 Y(s)。推理：设左侧求和节点输出为 e(s)。由于反馈信号来自 G_1 的输出并经过 H，所以反馈量为 H G_1 e(s)，且在左侧求和节点处被减去，因此 e(s)=X(s)-H G_1 e(s)。整理得 e(s)(1+G_1H)=X(s)，所以 e(s)/X(s)=1/(1+G_1H)。右侧求和节点把两条正向信号相加：来自 G_1 的信号为 G_1 e(s)，来自 G_2 的信号为 G_2 e(s)，因此 Y(s)=(G_1+G_2)e(s)。代入 e(s)/X(s)，得到 Y(s)/X(s)=(G_1+G_2)/(1+G_1H)。

method.method_draft: Treat the left part as a negative-feedback loop around G1 with feedback H. From X(s) to the output of G1, the equivalent transfer is G1/(1+G1H). The signal feeding G2 is the loop input/error signal, so its transfer from X(s) is 1/(1+G1H), making the G2 contribution to the final summer G2/(1+G1H). Since the final summer adds both inputs positively, add the two contributions: Y(s)/X(s)=G1/(1+G1H)+G2/(1+G1H)=(G1+G2)/(1+G1H).
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：输入 X(s) 从左侧进入第一个求和点；该求和点对输入端为正号，对下方由 H 返回的反馈信号为负号。第一个求和点的输出作为误差信号，一路进入 G1，另一路沿上支路进入 G2。G1 的输出向右进入最终求和点，同时分支向下经过 H 后反馈到第一个求和点的负端。G2 的输出也进入最终求和点；最终求和点处两路输入均为正号，输出为 Y(s)。推理：把左侧部分看作围绕 G1、反馈为 H 的负反馈环。设第一个求和点输出为 E(s)，则 G1 输出为 G1 E(s)，反馈信号为 H G1 E(s)。由负反馈关系，E(s)=X(s)-H G1 E(s)，所以 E(s)/X(s)=1/(1+G1 H)。因此从 X(s) 到 G1 输出的传递函数为 G1/(1+G1 H)。同时，G2 的输入就是误差信号 E(s)，所以 G2 对最终输出的贡献为 G2/(1+G1 H)。最终求和点将 G1 支路和 G2 支路正向相加，因此 Y(s)/X(s)=G1/(1+G1 H)+G2/(1+G1 H)=(G1+G2)/(1+G1 H)。
